hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/anastasia-state-park/experiences-amenities ('All sites have electricity and water') + Reserve Florida site details (107 sites list 30-amp and 13 list 50-amp electric; every site lists a water hookup), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Four bathhouses in the campground with hot showers and washers and dryers. A communal dump station, free for park campers. Food and a beach shop at the Island Beach Shop and Grill at the end of the main park drive.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/anastasia-state-park/experiences-amenities (Laundry / Restroom Facilities: 'The campground contains four bathhouses complete with showers, hot water, and washers and dryers'; RV: 'A communal dump station is free for park campers'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 139 sites for RVs and tents in seven loops in the maritime hammock (Reserve Florida lists 120 of them online, 84 'RV or Tent' and 36 tent-only). 'Maximum RV length = 38 feet'; the booking site's longest site lists 38 ft and every site is back-in. Some sites are paved.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/anastasia-state-park/experiences-amenities ('The campground has 139 sites for both RVs and tents'; 'Maximum RV length = 38 feet') + Reserve Florida search/details (Maximum Vehicle Length; all 120 listed sites 'Back In'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservations on the Florida State Parks reservations website or 800-326-3521. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on every campsite.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/anastasia-state-park/experiences-amenities + Reserve Florida search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all 120 sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the $28 campsite rate on Reserve Florida for every loop (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12, $35 with the $7 RV utility fee). Added 50-amp electric (most sites 30) and water at all sites, four bathhouses with showers and laundry, free dump station, 139 sites up to 38 ft, all back-in, reservable with a 14-night max. Not stated: sewer, season, booking window or same-day rule for this park, first-come policy. The park's pages refuse plain HTTP (403); read once each in the locked headless browser.
